Edge TTS 7.3.1 is distributed as an unmodified official PyPI wheel. Source: https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts . Most code is LGPLv3; srt_composer.py is MIT. See LICENSE and each installed package dist-info/licenses directory. Android plays the generated MP3 directly; it does not include the original QQ FFmpeg/SILK conversion. The public Mozilla CA bundle is from https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem (2026-10-20 snapshot); see the retained source header in that file.
